cfb:26OCT09FSULOU.lean: Louisville not to win by 7 or more: the betting market keeps moving toward Florida State, and the Seminoles' ground game should keep this within a touchdown.
news: Florida State has 18 players ruled out, including running back Samuel Singleton, receiver Devin Carter and several linebackers and defensive backs (SI, Tomahawk Nation).
Louisville quarterback Lincoln Kienholz is probable after being questionable last week; defensive captain Koen Entringer returns after missing two weeks (SI, Yahoo).
The line opened with Louisville favored by 6 and has dropped to about 3.5, a move toward Florida State (SI betting preview).
Louisville's defense has given up at least 27 points in each of its three losses; Florida State quarterback Ashton Daniels is a running threat with nine rushing touchdowns (SI, Predictem).
Warm and dry at an outdoor stadium; no weather concern.
cfb:26OCT09FSULOU.summary: Louisville is favored by about 3 to 4 at home tonight, but the line has moved toward Florida State all week and most analysts like the Seminoles to keep it close. Florida State has a long injury list (18 players already ruled out), while Louisville gets quarterback Lincoln Kienholz and defensive captain Koen Entringer back.

cfb:26OCT09IOWAWASH.lean: Slight lean to Washington with Iowa's backup quarterback starting, but the Kalshi board here only offers the Iowa side and the under prices are no bargain. No strong lean.
news: Iowa will start Jeremy Hecklinski; Hank Brown is out with an upper-body injury, per On3's Pete Nakos and Hawkeye beat writers.
Hecklinski has not started a college game; he was 5-for-5 in relief against Ohio State (Hawk Fanatic).
Washington gets two-year starting center Landen Hatchett back for the first time this season (Seattle Times via Union-Bulletin).
Demond Williams Jr. has been sacked 12 times in the past two weeks, tied for most in the country (Yahoo).
Husky Stadium is outdoors; about a 50 percent chance of rain at kickoff.
Most analysts favor the under on the total; the spread picks are split between Washington by a field goal and Iowa with the points (Covers, DraftKings Network).
cfb:26OCT09IOWAWASH.summary: Iowa's starting quarterback Hank Brown is out with a throwing-shoulder sprain, so backup Jeremy Hecklinski makes his first career start tonight on a short week at Husky Stadium, which is outdoors with rain in the forecast. Washington's quarterback Demond Williams Jr. has been sacked a lot and the Huskies are missing several running backs, so analysts expect a low-scoring game.

cfb:26OCT10INDNEB.lean: Indiana not to win by 12 or more. The wind, the home crowd and Nebraska's clean bill of health make a one-score game more likely than a rout.
news: Local forecasters expect south winds of 20 to 30 mph with gusts to 40 mph during the game (1011now, KSNB).
Injury reports are clean for both sides: Indiana is missing backup running back Khobie Martin, tight end Andrew Barker and corner Carson Williams; no Nebraska starters are out (247Sports).
Indiana quarterback Josh Hoover has thrown 15 touchdowns and no interceptions; Nebraska averages almost 10 penalties a game, fifth most in the country (SI, Adam Carriker).
Analysts are split: Covers and DocSports take Nebraska with the points, citing a look-ahead spot before Ohio State; the SP+ model has Indiana winning by a touchdown.
Indiana has covered the spread just once this season; Nebraska has covered four of five (FanDuel Research).
cfb:26OCT10INDNEB.summary: Two unbeaten teams in Lincoln. Indiana is favored by about 7 or 8, but Nebraska is 5-0 at home with a mobile quarterback in Anthony Colandrea, and Saturday's forecast calls for near-record heat with wind gusts near 40 mph. Indiana has covered only once in five games this year.

cfb:26OCT10STANND.lean: No strong lean. The blowout is priced in, and going over the total depends almost entirely on Notre Dame alone scoring into the 50s.
news: Notre Dame corner Leonard Moore (concussion) and linebacker Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa (thumb) are questionable; safety Brauntae Johnson and lineman Jason Onye are out (On3, ESPN).
Stanford's leading receiver Caden High is questionable and corner Brandon Nicholson is out (NDNation).
Quarterback CJ Carr has 13 touchdowns against one interception (One Foot Down).
The line opened at 35.5 and has moved to 38.5; about 86 percent of the money is on Notre Dame (WagerTalk). Covers projects 52-7.
cfb:26OCT10STANND.summary: Notre Dame is favored by close to 40 and the line has climbed from 35.5, with most of the money on the Irish. Notre Dame's two best defenders, Leonard Moore and Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa, are questionable, but Stanford's offense ranks near the bottom of the country and the Cardinal have lost conference games by 39, 28 and 54.

cfb:26OCT10TEXOKLA.lean: Texas to win is the safest call on the board, and Texas winning by 8 or more is a fair price given how little Oklahoma has scored.
news: Oklahoma rules out five players including receiver Trell Harris, running back Xavier Robinson and defensive back Jacobe Johnson; left tackle Michael Fasusi is doubtful (247Sports Thursday report).
Texas running back Hollywood Smothers is off the injury report and tight end Nick Townsend is probable (Burnt Orange Nation, Hook'em Headlines).
Oklahoma hasn't scored more than 14 points in its last three games and has allowed nine sacks in four games (Predictem, SI).
Every CBS Sports writer picks Texas; Covers puts Texas at about a 3-in-4 chance to win and predicts 24-13.
Some books have moved Texas from a 7.5-point favorite to 8.5 or 9.5 (Covers, Predictem). Hot and dry in Dallas.
cfb:26OCT10TEXOKLA.summary: Top-ranked Texas is favored by a touchdown or more at the Cotton Bowl, and Oklahoma's offense has been a mess, failing to score more than 14 points in any of its last three games. Oklahoma has five players out and its starting left tackle doubtful, while Texas gets running back Hollywood Smothers and tight end Nick Townsend back.

cfb:26OCT10TXAMMIZZ.lean: No strong lean. Missouri should win, but the price for a Missouri blowout isn't attractive and the injured safeties give A&M a puncher's chance.
news: Missouri running back Ahmad Hardy will not play; coach Eli Drinkwitz says he hasn't practiced yet (Yahoo, CBS).
Missouri lists safeties Santana Banner and Kensley Louidor-Faustin and linebacker Robart Woodyard Jr. as questionable; three of their top four tacklers (Gig Em Gazette).
Texas A&M receiver Terry Bussey is out for the season and Mario Craver is questionable (SI).
Marcel Reed has been pressured on over 40 percent of his dropbacks this year (Covers).
Missouri quarterback Austin Simmons has yet to throw an interception this season.
cfb:26OCT10TXAMMIZZ.summary: Missouri is favored by about 3 at home. Star running back Ahmad Hardy is still out recovering from an offseason gunshot wound, and Missouri's safeties are banged up, but Texas A&M has struggled to protect quarterback Marcel Reed and lost receiver Terry Bussey for the season. Most analysts side with Missouri.

cfb:26OCT10UCLAORE.lean: Oregon not to win by 14 or more. A first-time starter and several missing starters against the best offense Oregon has faced makes a two-touchdown win a lot to ask.
news: Dante Moore is out for Saturday; Dylan Raiola will start (ESPN, Big Ten injury report).
Oregon also lists receiver Jeremiah McClellan (broken foot), running back Simeon Price and lineman Trent Ferguson (out for the season) as out; safety Aaron Flowers is doubtful (On3, Yahoo).
UCLA receivers Mikey Matthews and Jonah Smith and lineman Sam Yoon are out (ClutchPoints).
Raiola has completed 30 of 36 passes with five touchdowns in relief this season (Yahoo).
WagerTalk and BettingPros both like UCLA with the points; the line has moved from Oregon by 12.5 to 11.5 (WagerTalk). Cool with a chance of rain at Autzen, which is outdoors.
cfb:26OCT10UCLAORE.summary: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore is officially out with a concussion, so transfer Dylan Raiola makes his first start for the Ducks against an unbeaten UCLA team averaging nearly 45 points a game. Oregon is also missing a starting receiver, a running back and a starting lineman, with a starting safety doubtful. Oregon is still favored by about 11 or 12.

cfb:26OCT10UGAALA.lean: No strong lean. The weather risk and the coin-flip line make this one to watch rather than bet.
news: Alabama athletics says there are no plans to change the game; meteorologist James Spann now calls the Saturday-night forecast favorable with winds under 15 mph (SI, 247Sports, On3).
Georgia running back Chauncey Bowens, receiver Thomas Blackshear and safety Tyriq Green are out; Nate Frazier is back (247Sports).
Alabama edge rushers Justin Hill and Desmond Umeozulu are expected to miss again; right tackle Jayvin James looks set to return (Roll Bama Roll).
The line flipped from Georgia favored to Alabama favored by 1.5; Covers, WagerTalk and NBC all lean Georgia with the points (WagerTalk, Covers).
Bryant-Denny Stadium is outdoors; a postponement to Sunday was the fallback plan if conditions worsened.
cfb:26OCT10UGAALA.summary: Two unbeaten teams in Tuscaloosa with Hurricane Isaias passing through Alabama. As of Thursday the game is still on at 7:30 Eastern, and the local forecast now has the worst wind and rain moving through Saturday morning with just lingering showers and light wind by kickoff. Alabama is favored by a point or two after Georgia opened as the favorite; most analysts lean Georgia.

mlb:26OCT102000CWSCLE.lean: The hitters at the top of each order getting a hit, run or RBI is the clearest bet here; Burke reaching five strikeouts is a fair price if he pitches most of the game as expected.
news: White Sox manager Will Venable will only commit to Sean Burke pitching 'in some form'; Burke hasn't pitched since Game 2, when he struck out six over 5 and a third innings and gave up one hit (MLB.com, Daily Herald).
Gavin Williams, who led the league in strikeouts this year, pitched the ninth of Game 4 and says he's good to go; reports say he may not go as deep (Heavy, NBC Sports).
Projected lineups have Miguel Vargas batting third for Chicago and Jo Adell batting cleanup for Cleveland (MLB.com).
Vargas has a hit in all five games against Cleveland in the last month; Adell has a hit in four of five against Chicago (slate game logs).
Mild and dry at Progressive Field, which is outdoors. Neither team lists any injuries of note.
mlb:26OCT102000CWSCLE.summary: Winner-take-all Game 5 in Cleveland Saturday night. The White Sox led the series 2-0 before the Guardians won twice in Chicago. Neither team has named a starter: Sean Burke is expected to start or pitch the bulk of the innings for Chicago, and Gavin Williams is Cleveland's likely starter after throwing 18 pitches in relief Thursday.

nba:26OCT09MEMCHI.lean: No strong lean. Preseason minutes are too unpredictable to bet with confidence.
news: Bulls center Nic Claxton is out for the whole preseason with a hamstring issue; Zach Collins is still rehabbing a hand (Yahoo/Bleacher Nation).
Grizzlies are expected to start Post at center with Stewart out and Edey on a minutes limit (Beale Street Bears).
Chicago's coach has said starters won't play long minutes, so the second half will be decided by reserves.
nba:26OCT09MEMCHI.summary: Preseason game at the United Center. Chicago is expected to start Josh Giddey, Norman Powell, Matas Buzelis and rookie Caleb Wilson, but coach Tiago Splitter has said he'll go deep into the bench. Memphis is reportedly without Isaiah Stewart and has Zach Edey on limited minutes.

news: Hawks' Henri Veesaar and Pacers' Johnny Furphy are out (ESPN injury list in the slate).

2026-10-09.overview: Big weekend: Texas and Oklahoma meet in Dallas with Oklahoma's offense sputtering and several Sooners hurt, so Texas winning is the outcome I'm most sure about. Oregon's starting quarterback Dante Moore is out against unbeaten UCLA, and Iowa is starting a backup quarterback on a short week at Washington tonight. Nebraska hosts Indiana in near-record heat with wind gusts around 40 mph expected, which makes a big Indiana blowout less likely. Georgia-Alabama is still on despite Hurricane Isaias, with the worst weather expected to pass before kickoff. The White Sox and Guardians play a winner-take-all Game 5 Saturday night with Sean Burke and Gavin Williams the likely arms; the best prices I see are Texas to win, Oregon not winning big, and the top White Sox and Guardians hitters getting on the board.

picks.reason: Tampa Bay's defense gives up very few rushing yards, and Javonte Williams usually lands well under this combined number. Analysts tracking his game logs note he has stayed under a lower line in most games this year.

picks.label: Tyler Goodson under 25 rushing yards
picks.reason: Tyler Goodson is the backup and has averaged only a handful of rushing yards a game this season. Javonte Williams is handling the lead role with nineteen carries in each of the last two games.

picks.label: Jo Adell 1+ hits + runs + RBIs
picks.reason: Adell is batting cleanup and has driven in four runs this series, including a triple off tonight's opener Hagen Smith, per MLB.com's game preview. He only needs one hit, run or run batted in.

picks.label: Miguel Vargas 1+ hits + runs + RBIs
picks.reason: Vargas bats second and has reached base eight times in this series, per MLB.com, with a hit in each of the last five games against Cleveland. One hit, run or run batted in gets this done.

picks.label: Spurs to win
picks.reason: Spurs beat reporters expect Wembanyama, Fox and Castle to start the home preseason opener, while Atlanta lost its first preseason game and lists four rotation players as day-to-day. Preseason is unpredictable, so I am not going higher.

picks.label: Javonte Williams under 90 rushing yards
picks.reason: Tampa Bay allows fewer rushing yards per game than almost any team, and Williams' rushing line at sportsbooks sits well below this number. Even a heavy workload rarely gets him near ninety against a front like this.

picks.label: Bucky Irving 50+ rushing yards
picks.reason: Irving has carried fifteen to seventeen times a game lately and Dallas gives up more rushing yards than nearly anyone. With a rookie quarterback, Tampa will lean on the run as long as the game stays close.

picks.label: Colson Montgomery under 1 hits
picks.reason: Montgomery bats ninth, is a lefty facing lefty Parker Messick, and has gone hitless in four of the last five games against Cleveland. Messick has been very tough to hit at this ballpark all year.

picks.label: Miguel Vargas under 2 total bases
picks.reason: Vargas keeps getting on base against Cleveland but almost always with singles and walks, exactly one hit in each of the last five meetings. Staying under two total bases just needs no extra-base hit.

picks.label: Cowboys win by 8+
picks.reason: Tampa Bay's final injury report rules out Baker Mayfield, so an undrafted rookie starts on a short week on the road, and star safety Winfield is out too. Dallas has scored at least four touchdowns every game and sportsbooks have moved this to about eight points.

picks.label: Washington win by 4+
picks.reason: Iowa's coach says they cannot count on starting quarterback Hank Brown, so a backup is set for his first college start in Seattle. Washington's quarterback is healthy and its starting secondary is back.

picks.label: Louisville win by 5+
picks.reason: Florida State has eighteen players already ruled out, including its lead back, a top receiver and six defensive starters or backups. Louisville's quarterback is listed as probable and the Cardinals have only lost close games.

picks.label: BYU not to win by 7+
picks.reason: BYU's coach says lead back LJ Martin and star linebacker Isaiah Glasker both look doubtful, with a starting safety also doubtful. Iowa State's offense is explosive enough to keep this within a touchdown.

Cowboys win by 8+
picks.reason: Baker Mayfield is officially out and undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels makes his second straight start, with top safety Antoine Winfield Jr. also out, per the Bucs' final injury report on Yahoo Sports and Bucs Nation. ESPN and VegasInsider show Dallas favored by about ten points now after opening as a small favorite, so winning by eight should be a little more likely than this Kalshi price suggests.

picks.label: Tyson Bagent under 2 passing TDs
picks.reason: Caleb Williams is out again with his hamstring and coach Ben Johnson confirmed Tyson Bagent starts in Green Bay, per RotoBaller and A to Z Sports. Bagent has not thrown a single touchdown pass in his six games this year and Chicago leaned on the run game to win last week, so two touchdown passes from him would be a surprise.

picks.label: Tyler Goodson under 20 rushing yards
picks.reason: Tyler Goodson is Dallas's third running back behind Javonte Williams and has averaged only a handful of rushing yards a game over his last thirteen (slate data). Even if Dallas runs out the clock late, he rarely gets enough carries to reach twenty yards.

picks.label: Under 46.5 points
picks.reason: Ja'Marr Chase did not practice Wednesday and is still in the concussion protocol per ESPN's Ben Baby, and Tee Higgins is day-to-day with a groin issue per Field Level Media. Miami is winless with new starter Malik Willis and the sportsbooks have this game expected to land in the low forties, so fewer than 47 total points is a comfortable spot even though unders have been poor for the tool lately.

picks.label: Texas win by 8+
picks.reason: Texas is the top-ranked team and the sportsbooks favor them by about nine or ten at the Cotton Bowl, per SI and Covers, while Oklahoma has scored two touchdowns or fewer in three straight games and sits last in its league in offensive efficiency. ESPN's model, our own ratings and Covers' projected score all have Texas winning by double digits.

picks.label: Kyler Murray under 2 passing TDs
picks.reason: Kyler Murray has averaged less than one touchdown pass a game in his eight games for Minnesota (slate data), and Justin Jefferson is still day-to-day with his ankle with Jordan Addison also questionable, per Newsweek and the Vikings' own report. Minnesota has been winning low-scoring games with its defense and ground game, so one or zero touchdown passes is the likeliest outcome.

picks.label: Cowboys win by 8+ + Under 46.5 points
picks.reason: Two games where a backup or struggling quarterback is on the wrong side: Tampa Bay's rookie against Dallas, and Miami's Malik Willis against a Bengals team that may be without Ja'Marr Chase. Both legs have the sportsbooks already leaning further our way than the Kalshi prices.

Texas to win
picks.reason: Oklahoma hasn't scored more than 14 points in its last three games and Thursday's SEC report lists five Sooners out with the starting left tackle doubtful. Texas gets running back Hollywood Smothers back and every CBS writer picks the Longhorns.

picks.label: Oklahoma not to win
picks.reason: Same outcome as Texas to win, a penny cheaper. Oklahoma's offense has been shut down three games running and it is short-handed up front per the SEC injury report.

picks.label: Miguel Vargas 1+ hits + runs + RBIs
picks.reason: Vargas bats third in the projected White Sox lineup (MLB.com) and has a hit in all five games against Cleveland over the past month. He only needs one hit, run or RBI in a winner-take-all game where every starter plays.

picks.label: Jo Adell 1+ hits + runs + RBIs
picks.reason: Adell bats cleanup for Cleveland (MLB.com) and has a hit in four of the last five games against Chicago. Sean Burke's role is unsettled and the White Sox bullpen is tired, so Adell should see plenty of good pitches.

picks.label: Oregon not to win by 14+
picks.reason: Oregon's starting quarterback Dante Moore is out (ESPN), so Dylan Raiola makes his first start with a starting receiver, running back and lineman also out. UCLA is unbeaten and scoring nearly 45 a game, so a two-touchdown Oregon win is a tall order.

picks.label: Indiana not to win by 12+
picks.reason: Lincoln forecasters expect wind gusts near 40 mph, Nebraska is unbeaten at home with no starters hurt, and Indiana has covered only once in five games. Covers and DocSports both like Nebraska to keep it close.

picks.label: Louisville not to win by 7+
picks.reason: The line has moved from Louisville by 6 down to about 3.5 and most previews like Florida State to stay close. Louisville's defense has allowed at least 27 points in each loss, and FSU's running quarterback keeps games tight.

picks.label: Texas win by 8+
picks.reason: Some sportsbooks now have Texas favored by 8.5 or 9.5 (Covers, Predictem), and Covers predicts 24-13. Oklahoma's offense hasn't topped 14 points in three games, so Texas by 8 only needs a normal day.

picks.label: Sean Burke 5+ strikeouts (pitching)
picks.reason: Burke is expected to start or pitch most of the innings in Game 5 and hasn't thrown since Game 2, when he struck out six Guardians (MLB.com, Daily Herald). He has averaged nearly six strikeouts an outing lately.

picks.label: Munetaka Murakami 1+ hits + runs + RBIs
picks.reason: Murakami bats fourth for Chicago (MLB.com) and has been producing well over two hits, runs and RBIs a game lately. Gavin Williams may not go deep after pitching in relief Thursday, so Murakami gets looks at the Cleveland bullpen.

picks.label: Nebraska to win
picks.reason: Nebraska is 5-0 at home with a running quarterback, Indiana is in a look-ahead spot before Ohio State, and gusty wind hurts Indiana's passing game. A couple of analysts take Nebraska outright, but this is a long shot.

picks.label: Texas to win + Miguel Vargas 1+ hits + runs + RBIs
picks.reason: The two outcomes I'm most sure about: Texas beats a struggling, short-handed Oklahoma, and Vargas, who has hit safely in every game against Cleveland this month, gets on the board once.
